in_sanskrit.name: भीम
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: bhīma (भीमासुर), derived from the word bhīmaasura (भीमासुर), meaning 'having the strength of a Bhimaasura', referring to Bhima, one of the Pandavas in Mahabharata.

in_marathi.name: Bhim
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhim हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhim is a name derived from Sanskrit and means 'powerful' or 'strong'. In Hindu mythology, Bhim is the second eldest of the Pandava brothers, known for his immense strength and courage.
